BREAKING: Spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted +$176 million in inflows on Tuesday, following +$110 million in inflows on Monday.

So far in October, $IBIT has seen +$986 million in inflows, putting it on track for its 4th consecutive monthly inflow, the longest streak since October 2025.

Over this period, the fund has attracted +$5.7 billion, turning year-to-date inflows back to positive, at +$3.7 billion.

Meanwhile, $IBIT assets under management (AUM) are up to $65.5 billion, near their highest since January 2026.

Demand for Bitcoin is rising again.
